_comment: THE PER-PROJECT GATE CONFIGURATION (ADR-013). The UNION of all roles' globs = this project's gated artifact space; each role's array = that role's jurisdiction (ADR-012). The CLAUDE.md § Role jurisdiction table mirrors per-role entries; spec-075/spec-077 assert they agree. The gate's hardcoded always-ignore guard (nodes/**, sessions/**, .claude/.active-role, CLAUDE.local.md, .git/**, .obsidian/**, /tmp, out-of-repo) wins over this file regardless of its contents. PORTABILITY: a non-SEM-IA project rewrites these arrays to its product roots (e.g. src/**, ios/**); the imported SEM-IA framework .claude/** is then simply absent here -> ungated (the tool, not the product) unless a maintainer role opts in. See .claude/role-scope.example.json. Globs: '**' = any depth, '*' = one segment. This (self-hosting) repo's declared artifacts ARE the framework itself.
